rows.title: Outcome of Board Meeting
rows.summary: Teja Engineering Industries Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on October 15, 2026.Pursuant to Regulation 30 and 33 of SEBI (Listing Obligations and Disclosure Requirements) Regulation, 2015 ( Listing Obligations ), with reference to the captioned subject, we hereby inform that the Board of Directors of the company at its meeting held today i.e. Thursday, October 15, 2026, inter alia, have considered, approved and taken on record inter-alia the following businesses:1. To approve the purchase of Car for business purpose for an amount to Rs. 40 Lacs;2. To avail Vehicle loan facility not exceeding Rs. 40 Lacs from Bank of Baroda;3. Considered and approved other business matters as per the Agenda of the Board Meeting including any Other Business matters with the approval of the Board/ Chairman.This information is also being uploaded on the website of the Company i.e., www.tejaengineering.com . Kindly note that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company commenced at 12.10 p.m. and concluded at 12.30 pm.
